title: Blonde Boy Hands on Hips in Suburban Driveway, 1960 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: Black and white snapshot of a young blonde boy standing confidently with his hands on his hips on a sunny concrete driveway in a suburban neighborhood. He wears a classic horizontal striped short-sleeved shirt, high-waisted shorts, folded white socks, and dark canvas sneakers. In the background, a typical mid-century ranch-style suburban house, lawn, young tree, and street mailbox are visible, capturing everyday American family life around 1960.
